title: mytestmodinwhichihaveblastingpotatoes
description: This is a mod that adds some interesting stuff to potatoes. Craft a potato into suspicious substance, then right-click to summon an insanely powerful fireball!
body:
This is a mod that adds (as of 1.0.0) 2 new items:

# The Suspicous Substance
Crafted from either one potato or one condensed dirt. Right click to shoot a ghast fireball but a lot more powerful! Be cautious tho u die if u shoot it too close. also can craft 64 potatoes from 2 suspicous substance, thus giving easy quick infinite potatoes

# The Condensed Dirt
Crafted from 1 suspicous substance, this serves as a quick to break temporary block that insta mines with ur fist. another crafting recipe is:

![hella expensive recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/52862cc3a37be9619c9d7edf8dee2dcbc0a873a2.png)

---

dependencies:
- java
- minecraft
- ur will to live
- fabric api
